name: io.github.opennodes-io/opennodes
description: OpenNodes discovery for AI agents: search verified AI inference nodes across registered operators and imported catalogs, get the best node + model for a task (advisor), and pre-price multi-step chains with enforceable estimates.

environment_variables.name: ONP_REGISTRY
environment_variables.description: Registry base URL. Default in 0.1.x is a local registry at http://127.0.0.1:4300 (run one with `npx @opennodes/registry`); set to the hosted registry URL once it is live.
